figures.Fig7.2: Change in HI concentration with time for 2HI -> H2 + I2 at 508 C. Original figure archived as c11-chem-ch7-fig-hi-tangent (drawn for this lesson; not the textbook's picture).
figures.Tab7.1: Change in concentration of HI at regular intervals. Carried as a table in the lesson.

findings: The print works the rate at 100 s as 0.04 / 100 = 4 x 10^-4 mol dm-3 s-1, but its Figure 7.2 shows the 0.04 drop over about 160 s and Table 7.1 gives about 2.5 x 10^-4 (the print's own '2.5 moles' line); the lesson uses 2.5 x 10^-4 and notes the print.
The figure caption says 508 degrees C where the text says 500.
